sentences.en: I mortgaged my farm to him for ten million yen.
sentences.zh: 我把农场抵押给了他，借了十亿日元。

sentences.en: I don't have enough money to pay the mortgage off.
sentences.zh: 我没有足够的钱来偿还按揭贷款。

sentences.en: Sami applied for a reverse mortgage to renovate his house.
sentences.zh: 萨米申请了一笔反向按揭贷款来翻新他的房子。
